item.summary: In Kautokeino, the mayor says the allocation of a plot for a planned data centre was handled politically, and the crypto company Arctic Core AS is still part of the plans, Ságat reports. According to the municipal director, the company is to test the possibility of a data centre over two years. The story follows earlier Ságat coverage of the company's plans in the municipality.
